Why Modal? Grok does the searching, through the xAI API. Modal runs everything around it. The job comes in bursts: one big parallel search, then nothing until the next check. A laptop script stops when the lid closes, and a server of your own sits idle all day. On Modal, a schedule runs the re-checks with no server to maintain. Map spreads the xAI calls across many containers at once. A Modal Dict stores the results, and a web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. The xAI key lives in a Modal Secret. When nothing is running, the app scales to zero, so you pay per second of work.
